title: Musical Instruments Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forscore:practice
| eval day_type=if(in(strftime(_time,"%u"),"6","7"),"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(duration_min) as avg_duration by day_type
description: Separates musical instruments activity between weekdays and weekends when duration is present.
value: Weekend/weekday splits quickly show whether a life domain is work-driven, leisure-driven, or bleeding into the wrong days.
implementation: Populate optional `duration_min` on `forscore:practice` events if available; the search still works on counts alone when duration is missing.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart of weekday vs weekend event counts.
grandmaExplanation: It works out whether your musical instruments activity mostly happens on weekdays or weekends so you can see if the habit fits the life you actually live.
